d: Room with four side doors, and one in the middle with compass, and curtains. Coffee table with letter to write. Various books, notebooks, and four chairs. Pippetto sitting at the coffee table, and Gregorio as a room walking, giving lesson; then Leonarda with silver cabarè, cup of milk coffee and biscuits, then Simone and Servi etc.
Don Giulio in a gala dress, come in, and put his hat on the coffee table, and then from the middle door Mr Gregorio in a decent dress to get out of the house.
Enrico comes out concentrated in depth, and painful thoughts, then Gregorio.
Simone, that's it.
Henry from his room, lead Gilda from the bottom, entering quickly, and watching.
Gregory from the bottom, and sayings.
Giulio inside from the bottom, and sayings.
Marquis Giulio from the bottom, and sayings.
Leonarda comes from the back door and knocks on Pippetto's bedroom, then Gregorio.
Gregorio from the bottom, then Henry from the room, then Gilda.
Pippetto, and Leonarda coming out of the room where they were hidden.
Pippetto, then Marquis Giulio.
Gregorio, that's it.

Leonarda, and Pippetto each from their rooms; then Henry from the bottom, and Waiters, and Servants with folders of prints; various well bound tomes, and two telescopes. Simone, then the Marquis from his room; all surround Gregorio.

Room in the apartment of Mr. Gregorio. Bring to the bottom, and another to the right. Scans of books, and above plaster bust of philosophers. Desk with address to write, papers, books, armillary sphere. On one side large clock over a bedside table. The bottom of the room is a wall of ancient cloth. Chairs. Henry and Gilda.
The moment Gilda goes to force the middle door into Gregorio.
Gilda, and Henry, say Marquis Giulio.
Gregorio, and sayings.
Gilda leaving quickly, and taking the child away from Gregorio.
Leonarda from the middle door running, and sayings.
Leonarda, then Pippetto, and Coro di servi, and Simone.
Gregorio, and Don Giulio from inside, go on stage from the middle door, then Gilda, and Henry from the inner chamber.
